topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the framing for the lecture by outlining its themes and learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor virology and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of tumor viruses led to the identification of cellular proto-oncogenes and the development of laboratory assays for cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanics of oncogenes and tumor suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer-associated mutations in oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes alter cellular regulation through distinct pathways and allele dosages.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular defects in DNA repair, replication, and mitosis that generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss how sporadic and inherited mutations accumulate during multistep tumor progression and influence disease development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing remarks and recommended reading.
